title: Indicator on matching vectors
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let a path on the binary cube $ br^n$ assign to each coordinate either no value or a value in $ br/2 br$, and let $x\in\bbr^n$ agree with every value assigned by the path. Then the indicator of the set of vectors matching the path takes the value $1$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A path on the binary cube of dimension $n$
A binary vector $x$ matching the path
